attacks.name: Sword Strike
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Bleed|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§bleed§Bleed| special condition.

attacks.name: Shield Throw
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
This attack ignores LOS, and the defender does not benefit from Cover.

|!wild| |*Ricochet|: After this attack is resolved, this character may make an additional |*Shield Throw| attack. This attack must target another character within |!range| 3 of the original defender, may be any distance from this character, and does not have the |*Ricochet| special rule.

attacks.name: Mnemonic Technique
steps: Add dice to the attack roll equal to the defender's |!physical| Defense.
The defender cannot modify or reroll dice in the defense roll during this attack.

superPowers.name: Photographic Reflexes
superPowers.body: After an attack targeting this character is resolved, this character may use this superpower. If the attacker is within |!range| 3, roll 4 dice. Deal 1 |!damage| to the attacker for each |!critical| and each |!wild| rolled. If the attacker has already targeted this character with an attack this turn, roll 6 dice instead of 4.

superPowers.name: Intuitive Pattern Recognition
superPowers.body: If an enemy character targets this character with an attack and has already targeted this character with an attack this turn, add 2 dice to the defense roll.

superPowers.name: Martial Artist
superPowers.body: When this character is defending against a |!physical| or |!energy| attack, if the attacker is within |!range| 2, this character adds Blanks in its defense roll to its total successes.

superPowers.name: Rogue Agent
superPowers.body: One character with |*Rogue Agent| counts as an affiliated character during Squad building.
